name: instant
author: Realmforge
description: The animation of every instant spell (RLM-641, ADR 0073 decision 8; Matěj, 2026-10-29): both hands push forward and back in half a second, the global cooldown. The arms draw in by tick 2, thrust forward by tick 5 and hold a tick; from the end tick (6) to the stop tick (10) they ease back to rest. Its length is the server's SpellCast#PUSH_TICKS, 10 ticks. Animates only the arms' rotations.
